name: Fried snails
summary: Ốc chiên is apple snail and spiral snail, fried with chili, fish sauce, and pepper, then finished with coconut, pineapple, chili, ginger, lemongrass, and lime leaf. It is not ốc khe from the fair, and it is not Minh Hóa’s ốc đực.
origin: Quảng Bình. Du khách on 31 Oct 2024, republishing Dân Việt.
howToEat: The snails are cleaned, seasoned with chili, fish sauce, and pepper, and fried over a high flame. When they take the seasoning, coconut, pineapple, chili, ginger, lemongrass, and lime leaf go in, until the snails are golden.
Eat them with green-mango salad or a salad, and with shrimp crackers or grilled rice paper, dipping the cracker into the sauce.
where: A Quảng Bình plate of apple snail and spiral snail.
seoTitle: Oc chien — fried snails in Quang Binh
seoDescription: Ốc chiên is apple snail and spiral snail fried with chili, coconut, and pineapple until golden.
